message.content: The stock for Keysight Technologies Inc closed at 333.42, trading above the 20-day average of 330.47 and the 50-day average of 326.21 while remaining below the immediate resistance high edge of 366.41. The latest quarter ended on 2026-07-31 with revenue of 1.85 billion, representing a growth of 36.5 per cent on a year earlier and 7.5 per cent on the quarter before, while earnings per share reached 2.82 against an estimate of 2.16. This performance drove net income to 397 million, a 107.9 per cent increase from the prior year, resulting in a net margin of 21.5 per cent and a gross margin of 65.9 per cent. Valuation metrics show a trailing price to earnings ratio of 45.89 and a forward price to earnings multiple of 20.66, with the trend state currently identified as an uptrend.
